description: This file defines classes and constants for managing front panel indicators, including color, blinking, brightness, and state control, within a device settings namespace.

classes.name: device::FrontPanelIndicator
classes.description: Manages front panel indicator properties such as color, blink sequence, brightness, and state.

classes.name: device::FrontPanelIndicator::Color
classes.description: Extends DSConstant to manage predefined colors for the front panel indicator.

classes.name: device::FrontPanelIndicator::Blink
classes.description: Handles blink interval and iteration settings for the indicator.

methods.name: FrontPanelIndicator::getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of FrontPanelIndicator by id or name.

methods.name: Color::getInstance
methods.description: Returns a color instance by id or name.

methods.name: FrontPanelIndicator::getBrightnessLevels
methods.description: Retrieves brightness levels, min, and max.

methods.name: FrontPanelIndicator::getMaxCycleRate
methods.description: Returns the maximum cycle rate for scrolling.

methods.name: FrontPanelIndicator::setColor
methods.description: Sets the color using a Color object or RGB value.

methods.name: FrontPanelIndicator::getState
methods.description: Returns whether the indicator is enabled.

methods.name: FrontPanelIndicator::getSupportedColors
methods.description: Returns a list of supported colors.
